notes.title: Community Message - PATCH 4.0.9d6c
notes.notes:
Dear Innkeepers and Crossroads Inn enthusiasts,

We are truly humbled by the journey we've shared with you in the creation and development of Crossroads Inn.

It began as a spark of an idea over a pint of beer among friends, imagining what it would be like to pivot the traditional RPG scenario, making the inn the bustling hub of action, rather than a temporary refuge.

From the initial concept to our Kickstarter campaign, the full game release, Anniversary Edition, and Season Pass, we've been dedicated to relentless improvement and innovation, striving to overcome both minor bugs and complex coding challenges.

Through this journey, we've stretched the capabilities of our development engine to their very limits, which has facilitated the many updates and enhancements you've seen. You can find a record of these updates here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/867290/view/3326486390755132161

We've now reached a point where we've maximized the potential of our current development engine. Despite our best efforts, some bugs have proven resistant to our attempts to rectify them, and we understand that this may not have lived up to some players' expectations. We want you to know that we've given it our all.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33317542/3e0b9f9bef5d45645509b0b4b13e15574208fe52.jpg

Given the constraints of our current development engine, we've made the difficult decision to halt further development of Crossroads Inn on this platform. Despite this, we are immensely grateful to all of you who have supported us on this journey. Your passion and dedication have been the lifeblood of this project, and we hope that you've enjoyed the countless hours spent managing your inns and crafting unique stories.

While we're concluding our current chapter, Crossroads Inn continues to be a project very close to our hearts, and we are excited about the potential for its future. We want to reassure you that the world of Crossroads Inn is far from over. Stay connected with us and our community. We've built something incredible together, and it's been an honor to share this adventure with you.

We recognize that we may not have met everyone's expectations, and for that, we sincerely apologize. We value your feedback and are committed to learning from this experience to improve and grow. We deeply appreciate your understanding, support, and patience as we navigate this transition.

We're confident that our future projects will continue to capture your interest and earn your trust. Our commitment to creating excellent gaming experiences remains steadfast, and we're excited to take our next steps, guided by your feedback and expectations.

The recently tested Beta branch has now been integrated into the main version of the game.

Thank you once again for your unwavering support. We look forward to continuing this journey together.

With warm regards,
The Crossroads Inn Team

notes.title: Patch 4.0.5 HOTFIX update
notes.notes:
Hello friends.

To briefly outline the state, a recent patch was released with a bunch of upgrades and a promised DLC - Booze and Liquor for owners of the season pass. And after that there was a quick hot fix, supported with your feedback and responses pointing out some snags.

Moreover, we mentioned earlier that issues regarding Act III were really tricky, required sharp cuts and, simply saying, more time to execute fixing. That was the sole reason for dividing it into two parts. 
[hr][/hr]
More to the point. Today, time has come to announce the release of the second part, hopefully bringing you more good than before. Main focus was obviously on the Act III, however we have some additional patch notes to proclaim, related to the some general issues.

Have a look at patch notes: 


 Fixed several issues regarding Act III

 Blocked the option to switch to a different path mid-quest.
 Fixed many broken dialogues leading to a dead end.
 The ending of the Baron’s path is now fixed.
 Fixed text not fitting in task window for many quests. 
 Fixed triggering and the content of the drunk Martyn’s dialogue.
 Fixed multiple ‘Conversation’ buttons present when right-clicked on Ganis.
 Fixed multiple subtasks when partnering up with fractions.

 Fixed the issue of cutscene playback speed relating to in-game speed. 
 Wells are working properly again for Sandbox and Campaign excluding Act 0.
 Fixed an issue where servants weren’t able to pick up dirty mugs and plates from tables. 


A note:
Please, be aware that this patch requires you to start a new game or load a save not older than the very end of Act II. 
We are aware that some issues mentioned by you are still not fixed, but we wanted to release fixed Act III as soon as possible because it was previously unplayable due to ongoing work on it.

Known issues:

 Seers fraction quest - you have to right-click on Martyn and choose ‘Conversation’ to talk to him and progress.
 Dishwashers do not show the number of objects they store.
 Well not working in Act 0.
 Issue of servers not serving food and drinks still does occasionally happen. During our testing, it happened once per many, many saves.


There’s no need to mention you can bring us your feedback on how the game works for you right now. We know that, even though the game is being fixed pretty often, we can count on you! 

Klabater team,

- Fixed the issue regarding problems with placing objects on floor -1.

 At the moment only innkeeper class workers (starting worker in sandbox and Martyn in a campaign) can collect dirty mugs and dishes and they will only collect them if you have no clean ones in storage.

Those changes are going through extensive testing as we speak to ensure that - hopefully - no more dead ends can be found.

We do apologize for all the mess and try clean it for you. Your involvement, affection and loyalty is highly appreciated! 

Klabater team,

notes.title: New 3.0.1 Patch & and an interview with artist Alina Lesnik
notes.notes:
Hi all! 

We all know that beginnings are the hardest. When it comes to Crossroads Inn Anniversary Edition we aim to lessen the burden. Firstly due to huge changes in Performance, UI, and Pathfinding but the most important factor is your feedback! Thanks to you we are able to deliver the first patch with fixes when not even 24h have passed since the release and we are still on track to provide you with more minor improvements! As a Community, your voice is the most important and your feedback is invaluable! Those changes are already available on the PC Steam version! For GOG.com, Mac OS & Linux those fixes will be implemented on Monday the 26th of October. Without further ado, here are Patch Notes 3.0.1:


 Added a possibility of turning off old DLC content in Options
 Added a possibility of reverting a change in AE that caused furniture to be assigned to specific rooms - players will be able to freely place the furniture in the rooms, one can find this in the options and it's called "Allow all objects in all Rooms"
 Horse Wagons will no longer stray off the road
 Removed gray, square background from banners and pelts


BUT WAIT! THAT IS NOT ALL! 

Some of our players will definitely remember the sweet voice of Alina Lesnik who recorded a song, exclusively for Crossroads Inn. You can watch the official video and listen to it here: 

[previewyoutube=hVKqky5oCcU;full][/previewyoutube]

In the Anniversary Edition, Alina became one of the bards in the game! She is our long-time collaborator, we admire her voice, and working with her is very, very exciting. She answered a few questions about her involvement in game development, we highly encourage you to read it until the end as there is an additional surprise waiting for you (at the bottom of the page).

[olist]
 How do you like the game in general?

When I first heard about Crossroads Inn I liked the concept very much. I loved playing The Sims when I was a kid and Crossroads Inn seemed to pick up the idea of that game, but in a much cooler medieval setting and with great storytelling.
When I tested the game shortly before it was released last year, it was clear that the team was passionate about this project: The details, the designs, and the music, the game was very enjoyable so far. There were a few bugs back in the days, but the team released many patches to fix those. For now, I can't wait to check out the Anniversary Edition! It looks like it will light up those rainy autumn days a lot!

 How did you feel making the song and clip?

For the song Forget me not, I teamed up with composer Marcin Pukaluk. The goal was to create a game based ballad that dealt with a sad love story but also was catchy and uplifting enough to suit the atmosphere of a medieval tavern. Marcin wrote the music first and I added the lyrics afterward. I am really happy how it turned out!
Filming the video for the song was a little bit tricky though! We went to my favorite forest in Germany and I had this self-made floral wreath and a sensitive white dress with me. It rained a lot between the shots and we improvised rain protection with garbage bags that covered the equipment and me. It was fun spending the day in the forest singing and dancing, I nearly felt like a forest spirit indeed

 What do you think about the new bard character based on your appearance?

I think it's a really cute idea and I am happy that the music is played in-game too. I bet if you would have told me last year that I would embody a bard in a video game, I would have said you're crazy! It feels really great and the team did a great job on the character  I don't have such splendid moves in real life though 
[/olist]

Innkeepers!

It is hard to believe, but Crossroads Inn was released nearly a year ago! It was a year of ups and downs, the emotional rollercoaster for both the fans and us, the dev team. 

Crossroads Inn became a very popular game, even though there are still issues requiring urgent improvement. Many ‘mixed’ Steam scores confirm this state of affairs and we are fully aware of that. For better or worse we have struggled with these issues, fixing some and falling while fighting others. But today we really have a special announcement… We are now gathering forces for the definitive ‘quality’ battle;).

We will share a lot of AE details in upcoming weeks, but we definitely want to finally take care of the most important and annoying problems:

-->Pathfinding - no more blocking on stairs, no more horses trying to reach stables through Inn’s main hall;)

-->Tutorial - Crossroads Inn is not an easy game, especially for beginners. This is why we now work on a complete tutorial with images & videos to help new players jump in. 

Ok, you will now probably ask how we plan to handle all of this if we couldn’t manage it until now. And this is of course a good question. Klabater team

Today's update brings the long-awaited fixes to Stairs, QoL features and UI improvements. Read on!

AI:
- Workers and guests will no longer fall and get stuck under Stairs.
- Goods will now be correctly carried upstairs and downstairs; if dropped for any reason, they will be instantly picked up.

If your workers are required to make a very sharp turn after getting off the stairs, and your game speed is set to Fast, occasionally they will look like they're stuck. However, that is not the case: they will start moving on their own after a few seconds. Rest assured that this behaviour is only temporary and more fixes are coming soon!

We would also like to use this opportunity to address a common misconception: the importance of FPS. At the moment, the game's engine is very sensitive to low FPS values. Playing on configurations that are too weak for the game can cause issues with pathing and AI behaviour. This is especially visible on Mac configurations, and when using Fast mode during gameplay. While we work on improvements to stability, please make sure that your software configuration allows the game to run smoothly at least on Low graphical settings.

Townsfolk - they hate foreign country decor, but love their own country decor, for all rooms.
Nobles - they don't trust low prices, but they don't mind high prices.
Travelers - they want to rent Guest Rooms more often. They will be very disappointed if the tavern does not have a Guest Room.
Outlaws - they don't care if the tavern is clean or not, they just want low prices and drinks. This social group is the most likely to steal, smoke pipes and cause fights.
Distressed - they don't feel good in fancy rooms.
 
Following these guidelines should help with quests that require a certain amount of influence for a faction.

notes.title: Post-release Community Update

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33317542/008227aebec597b22ab27737da25b17384a5cc32.jpg

Hi guys,

It’s Patryk here, Crossroads Inn Project Lead. Last few days were quite tough and filled with both positive and negative emotions in the same time. We started ecstatically while launching the game, seeing the hype train and your real excitement about Crossroads Inn – the game sells well, there are many great streams and clips around the net, etc. But pretty soon it came clear that some things didn’t go as planned. It is obvious for me as project lead that we owe an explanation and apologize to at least some of you who experienced serious issues with the game. And I want to do this in person. 

I’m sorry that we didn’t deliver the top quality on Day 1. We are small team and Crossroads Inn is our first big game. I think it may be fair to say that we were too confident about our  development process and testing (especially the latter!)

It seems that many gamers experienced and are still experiencing major issues with our game. I wanted to underline that we understand why many steam reviews are negative as we too understand anyone who refunded the game with feeling that it is not finished. What’s more, we treat all the negative comments as a proof of trust in us and in the game’s concept above all else! We hear you and each patch is getting us closer to the place where we wanted to be just after the release.

Speaking of which, we are now in ‘Terminator’ mode when it comes to patching the game. This means we have compelled a very detailed list of crucial bugs in the game, prioritized it internally, and now we have entered the phase of total elimination of these. You may expect a MAJOR PATCH on Wednesday. This will be a biggest patch until now and we really hope it to solve many of the most common issues.

I’m also fully aware that main issue still not solved is a problem with AMD cards (mostly those based on RDNA architecture) and missing texts in both menu and dialogues – all related with this glitch. Unfortunately we still didn’t work it out but I wanted to personally assure you that we are on a tripartite hot line with both authors of the game’s engine as well as AMD key programmers who are personally engaged in solving the issues. I can’t promise you that AMD issue will be solved in Wednesday patch, but we do our best to make it happen ASAP. 

You may expect many patches coming your way but I want it to be better tested and solid, so we will probably update the game biweekly now to give our testers more time to check all the improvements. 

This is our responsibility and we treat it very, very seriously. We owe you that and we fully recognize this fact. 

So, that being said, I wanted to thank you all who willingly contributed to our game in last few days. It is priceless that some folks spent their time to talk to us and to report to us instead of just negatively review the game. We are in your debt!!! And there are so many of you who did it! Hats off to you. And to all of you who play and enjoy the game, we are also so happy to see it. 

At the end of this pretty long dissertation, I wanted to ask you a favour. If you have negatively reviewed our game but still waited for patches and these patches worked for you – I would be eternally grateful if you consider changing the review. The game is now in much better shape and hopefully at least some of you can see it. Not to mentioned that we are working constantly to make it better! And we will. It’s a promise.

We are ok if you won’t do this and we are ok with the refunds – we don’t blame anyone else than ourselves. But if you like the game and if you haven’t experience any serious issues – you positive review would mean a world for us now. It will help to make our fight meaningful to see that you guys can finally enjoy Crossroads Inn in a shape we want it to be. 

Thank you for your support. 
Patryk Pietraszkiewicz
Crossroads Inn Project Lead

We are delighted to announce that Crossroads Inn, fantasy tavern management sim with RPG elements, previously funded on Kickstarter, is set to release on October 23 on PC/Linux/Mac via Steam and GOG store.

Crossroads Inn will debut in 2 diversified editions:

Standard Edition – 19,99 USD/EUR

 MEDIA: please send your request to lukasz.mach@klabater.com
 CONTENT CREATORS: please use Keymailer, Woovit or send you request to bartosz.slodownik@klabater.com


ABOUT THE GAME

Crossroads Inn is a real-time management sim with role-playing games elements. The game consists of two unique modes offering totally different experiences. In Sandbox mode gamers will focus solely on managing their business and economy – to build their very own tavern, hire and oversee staff, manage the supply chains and create new dish recipes. In Campaign mode, micromanagement is just a prelude to a rich story as the kingdom is in turmoil and a shift of power is expected. Your Inn will soon attract the attention of important political and military figures, who are desperately trying to hold on to the reins of power. Gamers will become part of a large-scale drama full of political intrigues, vivid characters, treacherous NPC’s and dangerous quests inspired by RPG games – You will even have a damsel in distress to save!


 Watch Sand Box mode gameplay
 Watch Story Trailer to learn more about the story in Crossroads Inn
 New screens available here ('Crossroads Inn' folder)


A list of features includes:

 Real-time management sim and RPG in one!
 Two distinct game modes: an epic Campaign mode with a non-linear story (12 different endings!) and nearly endless Sandbox mode dedicated to hardcore sim fans
 A rich and detailed lore with feuding factions and powerful organizations – choose to forge alliances or work against others in an original low fantasy setting
 Once in a lifetime culinary adventure designed in cooperation with the experts from Nerds’ Kitchen! Discover recipes, create new dishes and serve varied menus to attract different social groups 
 A complex tavern economy simulation with various groups of customers, special guests, unique and regular employees, dozens of resources and facilities to build and develop - all binded together with a network of reliances
 Original soundtrack composed by talented team including Marcin Przybyłowicz (The Witcher 3) and recorded with traditional folk instruments from various cultures and eras
 Expanded in-game culinary recipes along with a fully developed nutritional system created to influence relationships with different guests and fractions
 Extensive in-game editor that allows to fully modify game and to create your own campaigns, scenarios and adventures with access to all game assets


Crossroads Inn is scheduled for release October 23. The game is developed by Kraken Unleashed Studio and will be available on PC, Mac and Linux via Steam and GOG. For more information on Crossroads Inn visit:
